text:
Yes, there are two kinds of back-seat screen for the Model Y. Tesla doesn't make either, so both are aftermarket.

## 1. Mounted rear touchscreen (most people want this)
These 8.66" Android screens mount on the back of the center console and run video and apps. Most also add rear AC and seat-heating controls and wireless CarPlay/Android Auto. Prices run about $210-$360.

**Options from the results:**
- **Amazon, widest selection:** [Model Y rear screen listings](https://www.amazon.com/tesla-model-y-rear-screen/s?k=tesla+model+y+rear+screen). The two with the most reviews are the 8.66" Android 13 unit with 4GB+64GB at $329.99 (3.9★, 41 reviews) and the similar one at $319.99 (3.7★, 46 reviews). Both list Model Y 2019-2024 fitment. A $279.99 unit has a 4.5★ rating, but from only 2 reviews, so I wouldn't trust that number yet.
- **Tesery:** [8.66" Android Rear Entertainment Display](https://www.tesery.com/products/tesery-8-66-inch-rear-entertainment-display-screen-for-tesla), $359 for Model Y 2020 through March 2025. It has a 30-day return policy and a 4.7★ average, but the written reviews are mixed. One buyer reported lag, constant child-lock mode and apps that wouldn't update. Another called it "a little slow" but fine for a kid.

**My take:** Reviews across all of these are modest (roughly 3.2-3.9★ on Amazon). Expect some sluggishness. I'd buy from a seller with an easy return window, such as Amazon or Tesery's 30 days, and test it right away. Two other caveats:
- Fitment depends on your model year. Most listings cover 2019-2024. Tesery's Model Y option stops at March 2025, and I didn't see a confirmed fit for the 2025+ "Juniper" refresh, so check the listing for your exact year.
- Tesery notes that CarPlay and the Wi-Fi hotspot can't run at the same time.

## 2. Projector screen (no wiring)
The [Aurzen TravelPlay AutoCinema Screen](https://aurzen.com/products/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-screen-for-tesla-model-y) is $119.99 and clips into the roof. It turns the panoramic roof or rear window into a roughly 47-50" screen and doubles as a sunshade. It has several limits:
- It needs a separate portable projector, which isn't included.
- It's for parked use only.
- It's designed for the 2025-2026 Model Y. On 2020-2024 cars it works only in roof mode, and the rear panel doesn't fully cover the window.

A third-party deals site, [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-tesla-model-y), lists code CJ10 for $11.99 off. It says the code can't be combined with Aurzen's automatic sale prices, so check at checkout whether it beats the current $119.99 price.

## What I'd buy
- **For kids on road trips, with the car moving:** a mounted 8.66" screen. Start with the [Amazon listings](https://www.amazon.com/tesla-model-y-rear-screen/s?k=tesla+model+y+rear+screen) at $300-$330 and confirm your model year in the listing. Or pay a bit more for [Tesery](https://www.tesery.com/products/tesery-8-66-inch-rear-entertainment-display-screen-for-tesla) if you want a dedicated Tesla-accessory seller.
- **For movie nights while parked or camping, on a 2025+ Model Y:** the [Aurzen screen](https://aurzen.com/products/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-screen-for-tesla-model-y) plus a projector.

What model year is your Model Y, and is this mainly for driving or for parked use? With that I can narrow it down further.
